elements.element: The preferred obligations apply upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 17(d) applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”
Garman must, at Sparkling’s request, “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: The assistance must be provided “for a period of up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Garman must return to Sparkling “all of Sparkling’s data” in Garman’s possession or control.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 17(d)(ii) requires return within thirty calendar days of expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The data must be returned in a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the required standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor deletes Customer Data remaining after its return.
elements.evidence: Section 17(d)(iii) requires Garman thereafter to “delete or destroy all such data” remaining in its systems.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data thereafter.
elements.evidence: Garman must certify the deletion in writing to Sparkling after the return and deletion obligations.

elements.element: The fallback obligations apply upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 17(d) applies upon expiry or termination for any reason.
Garman must provide reasonable transition assistance at Sparkling’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The permitted assistance period is up to six months, which encompasses the fallback period of 90 days.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Returning all Sparkling data in a commonly used, machine-readable format constitutes a data export to Sparkling.

elements.element: Customer Data is exported within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return/export deadline is thirty calendar days after expiry or termination.

result.reason: The operative language satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also the fallback. It is not minimal because it additionally requires return and deletion of all Sparkling Confidential Information, a category potentially broader than Customer Data. The added subsection does not contradict the existing termination, software-return, perpetual-license, or refund provisions. Drafting quality is reduced because “delete or destroy” is followed by certification only of “such deletion,” and the deletion duty is limited to information remaining “in its systems” rather than all copies in Garman’s possession or control.
